FAQ

Questions about wholesale store software

What is the best software for a wholesale distributor?

One that offers a salesman order app, party credit control, batch stock, schemes, GST billing and collections. Sarvlekh builds this to your distribution flow.

Can salesmen take orders offline?

Yes. The app works without internet and syncs when connected.

Does it handle schemes and slabs?

Yes. Slab discounts, free goods and party-specific price lists are all supported.

Can the wholesale store system be customised to our way of working?

Yes. Every Sarvlekh system is shaped around your workflow — modules, roles, reports and approvals are configured with you, not imposed on you.

Can Sarvlekh connect the wholesale store system to Tally and GST?

Yes. Sales, purchase and payment entries flow into Tally automatically and GST-ready invoices are generated from the same data.

How quickly can we go live?

A focused first release usually goes live in weeks. We start with the modules that remove the most manual work and expand in stages.
